gen-dafont-joystix-gf-noto-sans-gurmukhi: Noto Sans Gurmukhi keeps its terminals pointing outward. Joystix is the loud arcade partner, widely tracked and chunky, while this plain sans stays tidy, with ascenders hugging the x-height, and that sharp difference in attitude is what makes the pair work.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-noto-sans-hanunoo: Chunky arcade swagger, spaced wide. Noto Sans Hanunoo fills most of its line height with lowercase and keeps its terminals open, so a long passage would feel sturdy and easy to follow beside Joystix.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-noto-sans-hebrew: Joystix spaces its letters wide and keeps its stems only slightly heavier than the arms joining them. And Noto Sans Hebrew, a plain sans with a big midsection, gives that arcade swagger a steady, open partner.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-noto-sans-hk: Bold arcade attitude comes from Joystix, with wide tracking and slightly thinner joins where curves meet stems. But Noto Sans HK, a sans with large lowercase and lifted brush ends, gives it a grounded counterpart.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-noto-sans-kaithi: Joystix brings widely tracked, bold arcade lettering. Noto Sans Kaithi, a sans-serif with an open e and lowercase that fills the line like capitals, would read in a long passage with a sturdy, easy rhythm.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-noto-sans-kannada: Approachable and contemporary, Noto Sans Kannada has s curves that open wide at both ends. But Joystix, bold and widely tracked, is the real spark, and that arcade-versus-friendly gap is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-noto-sans-lepcha: Wide-tracked, arcade-bold, unmistakably Joystix. Noto Sans Lepcha, a plain sans with wide curve openings and capital-sized lowercase, gives it a sturdy, approachable partner, and that mix of loud and friendly is the strongest thing about them.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-noto-sans-limbu: Noto Sans Limbu has tall-bodied small letters and curves that gape open, which makes it feel approachable beneath Joystix. The arcade heading and this sans feel like loud and friendly neighbors.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-noto-sans-lisu: Joystix is bold and widely tracked, with a faint crayon-like thick-thin rhythm. Noto Sans Lisu follows with tiny gaps above its x-height and wide-open s curves, so a long passage would read smoothly and steadily.
